2609.02783.title: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
2609.02783.paper_summary: Evaluating LLM agents is essential for guiding their development, yet it has grown prohibitively expensive: a single pass of a frontier model over an agentic benchmark can cost hundreds to thousands of dollars, a price paid repeatedly across iterative development cycles. Prior efforts, centered on benchmark distillation, reduce the number of evaluation tasks but leave the cost of executing each retained task untouched. In this work, we introduce early outcome prediction, a complementary axis of efficiency that instead cuts cost within each task. Our key insight is that an agent's final outcome is often evident from its intermediate behavior well before execution completes. We instantiate this idea in EarlyEval, a lightweight framework that trains a pair of LightGBM success and failure classifiers over behavioral, textual, and reference-solution features, and halts an agent run the moment either classifier crosses a calibrated confidence threshold, adding negligible per-step overhead. Across three benchmarks, SWE-bench Verified, TerminalBench, and Toolathlon, EarlyEval can eliminate 13%-26% of agent steps and up to 44.1% input tokens and 29.4% output tokens at 89%-97% prediction accuracy, while perturbing per-agent resolve rates by only one to two percentage points on average.
2609.02783.paper_summary_zh: 評估 LLM 代理對於指導其發展至關重要，但這已變得過於昂貴：對於一個代理基準進行一次前沿模型的評估可能需要數百到數千美元，這一價格在迭代開發周期中反覆支付。先前的努力集中在基準蒸餾上，減少了評估任務的數量，但執行每個保留任務的成本仍然沒有改變。在這項工作中，我們引入了早期結果預測，這是一個補充的效率軸，旨在降低每個任務內的成本。我們的關鍵見解是，代理的最終結果通常可以從其中間行為中明顯看出，遠在執行完成之前。我們在 EarlyEval 中實現了這一想法，這是一個輕量級框架，訓練一對 LightGBM 成功和失敗分類器，基於行為、文本和參考解決方案特徵，並在任一分類器越過校準的信心閾值時立即停止代理運行，增加的每步開銷微乎其微。在三個基準測試中，SWE-bench Verified、TerminalBench 和 Toolathlon，EarlyEval 能夠消除 13%-26% 的代理步驟，並在 89%-97% 的預測準確率下減少高達 44.1% 的輸入標記和 29.4% 的輸出標記，同時平均僅對每個代理的解決率造成一到兩個百分點的擾動。
